preregistration_revision_note: Revision 2 hardens the protocol before execution and before any M3 result existed or was observed: G5 becomes diagnostic-only because its 2/19 base rate is too unstable for a gate; Wilson intervals, deterministic review ordering, blind self re-review, anchoring limitation and abort semantics are locked. G1-G4, the runtime, baseline, rubric and negative scope are unchanged.
research_question: Does the unchanged Vietnamese runtime produce Vietnamese answers that are correct, grounded and supported by application-owned citations?

interpretation_boundary.m2_vi_runtime_candidate_result: REJECTED under the M2 component-level conjunction of semantic fidelity and retrieval quality
interpretation_boundary.reason: The frozen English G0 baseline is itself not production-ready; M3 can test Vietnamese-specific degradation, not certify the whole product.

evaluation_scope.exclusion_policy: Carry forward the frozen Reliability V1 exclusion for q-023 because its Ground Truth may under-credit valid evidence. Execute and retain the output, but do not include it in primary gates.
evaluation_scope.abstention_scope_note: M3 cannot estimate out-of-scope abstention correctness. A separately frozen Vietnamese OOS benchmark is required for that claim.

runtime_flow: G0 with original Vietnamese question, English evidence and answer_language=vi

runtime_call_policy.startup_failure_policy: A failure before the first model call is an infrastructure abort and creates no result attempt artifact.
runtime_call_policy.runtime_failure_policy: A provider, contract or runtime failure after execution starts is recorded as evaluation data, makes G1 fail, and stops the attempt immediately without retry or continued execution.
runtime_call_policy.external_interruption_policy: An external process or machine interruption retains any partial raw output and writes status=aborted_incomplete. A rerun requires a new attempt ID and explicit user approval; no attempt may be deleted or cherry-picked.

primary_gate.rule: All G1-G4 conditions must pass. Passing means Vietnamese parity candidate accepted for the next integration decision; it does not mean production-ready.

conditions_all_must_hold.name: runtime_integrity
conditions_all_must_hold.condition: 20/20 records complete with runtime_status=passed, original_query unchanged, answer_language=vi, one translation call, one generation call, Dense Top 3 and zero retries

conditions_all_must_hold.name: language_compliance
conditions_all_must_hold.condition: Every non-null final answer is reviewed as Vietnamese or Mixed technical terms acceptable; zero Not Vietnamese labels

conditions_all_must_hold.name: strict_end_to_end_non_inferiority
conditions_all_must_hold.baseline: 7/19 matched frozen English strict end-to-end successes

statistical_reporting.report_format: For each proportion report numerator, denominator, rate and Wilson 95% interval. Language compliance uses non-null final answers as its denominator.
statistical_reporting.resolution_limitation: With only 19 primary records, the gate cannot reliably resolve differences smaller than approximately 3-4 questions. A result crossing a threshold by one question must not be interpreted as precise parity or inferiority.

strict_answer_success_diagnostic.reason_removed_from_primary_gate: At n=19 and a matched English rate of 2/19, requiring at least 2 successes has an exact binomial false-fail probability of approximately 0.390953 when the Vietnamese branch has the same underlying success probability. The base rate is too low to support a stable promotion gate.

metric_definitions.decision_correct: Evidence sufficient requires decision=answer; evidence insufficient requires decision=abstain.
metric_definitions.strict_answer_success: Primary-scope record with evidence sufficient, decision=answer, answer correctness=Correct, completeness=Complete, groundedness=Grounded, citation support=All support, and output language compliant.
metric_definitions.strict_end_to_end_success: Strict answer success when evidence is sufficient; decision=abstain when evidence is insufficient.
metric_definitions.language_compliant: Vietnamese grammatical answer; ordinary English technical terms are allowed under Mixed technical terms acceptable.
metric_definitions.citation_support: Judged only against the application-owned selected citation excerpts, not unselected Top 3 evidence.

human_review.blindness_policy: The worksheet does not expose M2 translation adjudication labels. Translation/retrieval diagnostics are joined only after final-answer review.
human_review.anchoring_limitation: The same reviewer previously adjudicated M2 on these intents and may remember some translation failures. Hiding labels and randomizing rows reduces but cannot remove this memory-based anchoring.

worksheet_order.method: Sort ascending by hexadecimal SHA-256 of UTF-8 seed + ':' + intent_id; intent_id is the deterministic tie-breaker.

blind_self_re_review.selection_method: Exclude q-023, sort ascending by hexadecimal SHA-256 of UTF-8 seed + ':' + intent_id, select first 6.
blind_self_re_review.reporting: Report percent self-agreement separately for each reviewed dimension and for derived strict outcome.

diagnostic_only: strict answer success count/rate/Wilson 95% interval; frozen matched English reference is 2/19 and this is not a promotion gate
negative_scope: no translator prompt, model or parameter change
no Dense, Gold, index, metadata or Ground Truth change
no G0 prompt, model or parameter change
no query expansion, BM25, RRF, reranker or external evidence
no retry, output selection or post-result tuning
no modification or reinterpretation of frozen M2
no out-of-scope abstention or production-readiness claim
